0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Mussalfret is awfully worried about something.

1.original: Mussalfret informs you that his son, Verpaulaine, has recently fled the family home after a fight and asks you to try and convince him to return. You head to a local park in search of the disgruntled youth.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

2.original: You find Verpaulaine, but he vanishes once more. Undeterred, you begin your search anew.

3.original: After tracking down Verpaulaine, you learn that he is concerned by a change in the color of Labyrinthos's artificial sunlight. The boy says he wishes to look into the cause himself and you gladly agree to help him.

48.original: Oh, what am I to do?

49.original: Ah, you're that adventurer who helped out the Students of Baldesion, aren't you? I suppose it matters not to you, but my son seems to have run away...

51.original: Why was there a child here in the first place?

52.original: I thought only researchers lived here.

53.original: Ah, yes. Simply put, my wife and I work at Aporia and she happened to conceive whilst we were living here in Sharlayan Hamlet.

54.original: I assure you we had many sleepless nights wondering if we should quit our jobs and leave Labyrinthos, or entrust the child to a friend of ours who dwells somewhere more suitable.

55.original: Ultimately, we decided to continue our work whilst raising the child here. After all, our research is focused on the very future that our offspring will inhabit.

56.original: The issue is, however, that the magic that prevents us from revealing anything confidential is too potent to be used on children.

57.original: Of course, we can't allow the little one to roam freely─there's no telling what he might impart unto others─so he has spent his entire life thus far within the confines of Sharlayan Hamlet.

58.original: We recently had a slight spat with him and, well, he decided to flee.

59.original: I imagine me going after him would only make things worse. Could I ask you to talk to him in my stead? I'm sure he'd be much more willing to listen to...er, anyone other than his parents, at this point.

60.original: Thank you! Verpaulaine─my boy─is most likely in the plaza to the east. I cannot imagine he struck out any further on his own.

61.original: Verpaulaine ought to be in the plaza to the east. Or so I hope...

63.original: I am <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> going to go home so easily!

64.original: You probably won't believe me either, but I've noticed that all is not right in Labyrinthos.

66.original: Why don't you try telling me first?

67.original: I can decide what to believe on my own, thank you.

68.original: Fine, I shall tell you what I've seen. The color of the artificial light here changed recently.

69.original: I'm sure most people haven't noticed, but when you've spent your whole life here, the difference is like...like night and day!

70.original: Even so, no one will take me seriously when I bring it up. All because of my age! Got into a big fight with Father about it...

71.original: But Labyrinthos is in danger! Who knows what would happen if the artificial sun broke...

72.original: That's why I can't go home just yet. I need to get to the bottom of this first.

73.original: Although...I am scared to venture outside on my own. They say there's countless monsters out there...

74.original: I don't suppose you would come with me? I could pay you! It's not much, but I do get pocket money from my parents.

77.original: You don't need to pay me.

78.original: I thought you were different from the rest, but now you're treating me like a child too.

79.original: This is a proper deal, all right? You've got to take my money to make it binding.
